decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be completed in the materials specified on the approved plans and within the planning application form, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (L1112/2.3/01, L1112/2.1/02, L1112/2.1/03, L1112/2.1/04, L1112/2.1/05, L1112/2.1/06, L1112/2.1/07, L1112/2.1/08, L1112/2.1/09, L1112/2.1/10, L1112/2.1/11, L1112/2.1/12, L1112/2.1/13, L1112/2.1/14, Perspective Views 1-4, Design & Access Statement, Acoustic Survey Report, Energy Statement, Statement of Community Involvement, BRUKL Output Document, BREEAM Pre-Assessment Report, Transport Assessment Received 06/11/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans. The works shall be completed prior to the occupation of any part of the hereby approved development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - If within a period of two years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation

Condition : 7 - The hereby approved development shall not be occupied until the area shown as "Playing Field Grass" on the plan attached hereto has been laid out in accordance with L1112/2.1/07, and that area shall not thereafter be used for any purpose other than as a play area.

Condition : 8 - During construction works an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be provided to remove mud, stones and any other extraneous materials from the wheels and chassis' of construction vehicles exiting the site and all loads of construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter shall be fully covered in order to ensure that no material leaves the site attached to the vehicle which might subsequently be deposited on the highway. The exit from the wheel washing system shall be constructed from a hard, non-porous surfacing material and sited as far away from the exit to the highway as is possible given the constraints of the site and the surface shall be kept clean at all times. Waste water discharged from the wheel washing system shall be stored and disposed of on site and shall not be discharged into the public sewerage system without prior removal of soil, stones and any other suspended material. Suitable measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties shall also be provided in accordance with the guidance at http://www.london.gov.uk/mayor/environment/air_quality/docs/construction-dust-bpg.pdf and site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers on public highways and so as not to direct light into any windows of properties outside the site. Start of works on site shall be notified to the Council's Community Environment Team on 020 8583 5070.

Condition : 9 - The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the details approved in Energy Statement (SPE/470/V1) and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the London Plan policies.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and two storey rear extension comprising classrooms with associated landscaping works and additional parking spaces to the front
